ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Program Location Whitelisted In Firewall Via Netsh.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Netsh command execution that whitelists a program located in a suspicious location in the Windows Firewall

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\netsh\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "netsh\.exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*firewall.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*allowedprogram.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*advfirewall.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*firewall.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*rule.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*action\\=allow.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*program\\=.*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\\\$Recycle\\\.bin\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\RECYCLER\\\.BIN\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\RECYCLERS\\\.BIN\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\SystemVolumeInformation\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Default\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\addins\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\cursors\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\debug\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\drivers\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\fonts\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\help\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\tasks\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Local\\ Settings\\\\Temporary\\ Internet\\ Files\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet\\ Files\\\\Content\\\.Outlook\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%Public\\%\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%TEMP\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%TMP\\%.*")))
